claims.claim_text: The indexed Pierre Crabites is identified with high confidence as the American judge of the Mixed Courts of Egypt who later served in the Foreign Service Auxiliary at Baghdad.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Pierre Crabites, American judge on the Mixed Courts in Egypt, 1911-36.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Official and contemporary institutional sources link the rare exact name to the same judicial title, retirement, 1943 Baghdad assignment, and death there.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The distinctive exact name, specific title, Egypt expertise, retirement context, and wartime Baghdad service align across independent official and institutional sources. No direct personnel-file linkage was accessible.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources establish a 1911-1936 court career and a 1943 Foreign Service Auxiliary assignment but do not date the indexed OSS association.
claims.match_notes: High confidence preserves the missing direct OSS bridge; the 1943 diplomatic assignment is not silently labeled pre-OSS.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official FRUS editorial footnote identifies Crabites's position and gives the inclusive years; the 1943 journal independently calls him a former American member.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The distinctive exact name and precise judicial title align with the high-confidence identity assessment.
claims.temporal_assessment: The 1936 end date makes this a documented prewar affiliation, not proof of the immediate pre-OSS affiliation or last civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: The court role is modeled as a government assignment. No later Louisiana residence or Baghdad appointment is recast as an employer claim.

claims.claim_text: Pauline G Craft's printed private identifier conflicts with an official Army record naming Paul G Craft, so no Army attributes are assigned to this OSS index entity.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The complete Army scan found one row for the index identifier, but its first name is Paul rather than Pauline.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Identifier agreement is strong evidence of a relationship, while the conflicting first name prevents confirmation and could reflect an index error or a different person.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army row records entry on 14 July 1943 but cannot safely be attributed to Pauline or placed in her OSS chronology.
claims.match_notes: No grade, occupation, branch, or other attribute from the Army row is transferred. The full identifier remains private.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The rare exact Pierre Crabites name is tied by official FRUS and contemporary Foreign Service Journal evidence to the same American Mixed Courts judge and 1943 Foreign Service Auxiliary officer. The reviewed sources do not directly date or describe his OSS association.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 151 to establish Crabites's OSS role, accession date, and whether the 1943 Baghdad assignment preceded or overlapped it. No reliable immediate pre-OSS affiliation or last civilian employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
